## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Barcelona, Spain. It starts at 7,Passatge de la Banca.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> On La Rambla, right in the heart of Barcelona, stands the New Wax Museum of Barcelona. It's been completely revamped with a fresh concept and updated figures, using the latest tech to create an unforgettable visit.
>
> Inside, 28 scenes blend history and current events with over 150 figures. You can join the famous heist from the TV series "La Casa de Papel," sing with Rosalía or interact with icons like Pau Gasol or Messi. Plus, there's an amazing view of Barcelona from the elevator!
